selection: Eligible under both scopes: mean of All/Last mean(raw utility, native-prior utility, macro utility), then mean H, mean refusal F1, fewer ext blocks, lower layer, lower C, lexicographic policy. If no eligible candidate, use registered no-block/no-refusal policy and report failure.
calibration: five grouped fact folds on validation; shared All/Last calibrators fitted to pooled scope outputs excluding held-out facts; external mean probability across five frozen calibrators. Other methods use their own five grouped temperatures.
interaction_selection: validation mean of raw/native-prior/macro utility, then H, then lower threshold
native_prior: Unenriched calibration+validation facts: observed Closed-Book exact-match proportion, frozen before blind access. Blind observed rate is descriptive only.
primary_family: 40 two-sided whole-fact paired-swap tests jointly Holm corrected: A=18 utility; B=2 Last H vs Vanilla/CAD +2 All-minus-Last spontaneous refusal (blocked param/abstain); C=18 All F1/ECE/Brier vs3 baselines x2 views. Required directions explicit; failure of any condition means that omnibus claim is not confirmed.

guardrails.rule: Paired percentile 95% CI lower bound must exceed negative margin; descriptive guardrails, separate from primary randomized superiority tests.

blind_access: No blind inputs/labels/features/Closed-Book/RAG in development job. Fixed input list/hash is locked before target-model generation; blind package built only after development freeze and local audit.
three_b_status: sealed; no further model generation, retraining or tuning
llama_plan: Same preregistered hypotheses and protocol with model-specific metadata, tokenizer eligibility and independently fitted gate; sequential if verified license/access and remaining second-account resources permit. No automatic account rotation or license agreement acceptance.
